page.layout: One page of text, full width; below it a decorative border, the word "Elenchus" right-aligned, and a second decorative border. Page number [84] printed at the head. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: A. Ad ista vero quis idoneus? quis stabit coram devorante hoc Igne?

B. Suo nullus mortalium merito ; sed bono sis animo contremiscens peccator: Ecce vocat te, non quia tu dignus es conviva ; sed quia ipse benignissimus, idemque clementissimus, Hospes. Accede, Crede, Resipisce, & manducasti.

page.notes: The ornamental borders are printer's ornaments, not transcribed. The word "Elenchus" is set right-aligned in the lower part of the page. Some words are in the text as printed; the printed spelling "Hofpes" and "Refipifce" is rendered here as printed, with "Hospes" and "Resipisce" as printed in the scan.
